summary: Booking Holdings Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for an offering of three series of senior unsecured notes due in 20XX–20XX. The offering size, interest rates, maturity dates, and underwriting discount are left as blanks pending final pricing. The notes will rank senior to subordinated debt and equal with unsecured debt, but effectively subordinated to secured debt and structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities. Proceeds will fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
